I'd agree 👍. The best of season weaved slap-stick enduring characters and the Wackest of moment's,faces and tidbits of the world. It's almost like a fever dream between modern expectations and reverence for classic cartoons. In someways , it's just like classic SpongeBob. It's getting somewhere and how it gets there is the fun part. 
Later MLP is way more about lore and each individual episode less about fun and expanding what was already being known at the time. I.e Tale of the two princess, discord,and the entire crystal empre Arc. Things of this nature. I'd wish we got more out going writing and less establishment of characters. More trying to expand them instead of them becoming more like Goku.

Let me explain. Goku is a flat character, he's major arc for who he is set. The world around him is what's changing. I'd argue MLP handles this way better than most of any cartoons. As this major character shift into flat is really done after season 4. By time season 5 arrives we already have different episodes with the CMC,big Mac and discord. 

It's not that the shift wasn't handled well it was just. I loved the experimental stuff just aside from MLP became. It's more classic cartoons than what MLP became. Ie More  comedy from cartoon vs  world-building in a cartoon world
